## v1.37.0

Live sessions use the per-session TURN credentials the server sends. No code change is needed, but a media channel that keeps failing now ends the session (see Behavior change).

### Added

- `normalizeServerTurn` and `iceServersFor` are exported from `./experience`. (#424)

### Changed

- Sessions use the per-session TURN credentials the server sends, listed before the existing TURN entry. Sessions still connect when the server sends none. (#424)
- When both entries use the same relay host, each UDP address goes to one entry only, so media stays on UDP while the relay accepts just one of them. The split compares host names. (#424)
- Credentials close to expiry are renewed on a fresh socket before the SDK opens new relay connections, for example on `resume()` after a long pause. (#424)
- `turnCredentials` for another TURN host are still used alone, as before. The SDK reads `turnCredentials` once, when the session is created. (#424)
- A server `turn` with an empty or missing `url` uses the `turnServerUrl` host, unless you pass `turnCredentials`. (#424)
- If the browser or the relay (401) refuses the server's TURN entry, later peers use the configured entry alone. The logger gets one `[turn]` warning. (#424)
- If the relay (401) or the browser refuses the configured entry and the server entry is in the list, later peers use the server entry alone. (#424)
- The logger gets one `[turn]` warning when a session has no TURN server at all. (#424)
- `KalturaScriptedVideoSession` accepts `turn` as a host, `host:port`, full `turn:`/`turns:` URLs or a list, with `credential`, `password` or neither (the default credentials apply). A `turn:` URL with no port gets the standard ports and transports, as before. (#424)
- The socket connect query carries `sdk` with the SDK version. (#424)

### Behavior change

- A channel that needs a third recovery with no ICE up since the first one ends the session with `reconnect_failed`. Before, the mic uplink could keep recovering with no end. (#424)

### Docs and skill

- `avatarSessions.initClient()` docs: `turn` holds the TURN host and credentials for that session. (#424)
- TURN sources and the server `turn` field: [audio-channels.md §5](https://github.com/kaltura/intelligent-agents-sdk/blob/v1.37.0/docs/wire-protocol/audio-channels.md#5-asr-uplink-pc1-microphone--server). (#424)
